openers: Hi Priya, I’m Henry Finn from Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I’m really interested in how AI is reshaping open source, especially with creator tools and IP development.

Hello Priya, I saw you’re a Director at Django Software Foundation and involved in community building. I’ve been working on AI-powered anime and comics projects and would love to hear your thoughts on AI agents in open source.
plan.followUp: Thank you for the great conversation about AI and open source at the session. I’d be interested in exploring any collaboration opportunities between Unicorn Studios and the Django community, especially around AI agents and creative tools.
